condition3_mutations_comment: The fixed mutation rows scripts/run_relay_authority_mutations.sh runs, in order. Not read by check_relay_authority_contract.py; kept honest by tests/test_relay_authority_mutations.py, which runs the script and compares the MUTATION_RESULT names, mutated files and named targets against this list. The declared floor stays four; S4-m5/S4-m6 are the #5071 relay-tail S4 destructive-fence rows and S4-m7 is its r2 repair row, which reopens the fence's judge/commit window instead of neutering the verdict.
